description: This is a C source file implementing JSON querying functions using cJSON library, including command-line parsing, JSON file reading, and path-based JSON element search.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for command-line JSON search utility, parses arguments, loads JSON file, performs search, and outputs result.

methods.name: cJSON_SearchFile
methods.description: Reads a JSON file, parses its content, and searches for a JSON element at a specified path.

methods.name: cJSON_Search
methods.description: Searches within a cJSON object for a specified path, supporting nested objects and arrays.

methods.name: is_index
methods.description: Determines if a string represents a numeric index for array access.
